apiBoundary: src/services/api.ts — all backend calls go through this module; no inline fetch/HTTP in components

build.UNIT_TEST: MANUAL: no unit runner configured — the gate is TYPECHECK + LINT + BUILD (plus E2E_TEST where specs exist). Add Vitest + React Testing Library, then point UNIT_TEST at 'npx vitest run' and add it to the ts|tsx mapping.

researchLayers.name: components
researchLayers.targets: src/components/, composition, props contracts, styling usage

researchLayers.name: state
researchLayers.targets: src/contexts/, custom hooks, URL-driven state, window events

researchLayers.name: api-types
researchLayers.targets: src/services/api.ts methods, src/types/ shapes, backend contracts, auth/session lifecycle

researchLayers.name: build-config
researchLayers.targets: vite.config.ts (proxy, aliases), env vars, eslint/tsconfig, e2e config

manualVerificationSurfaces: Dev server route — npm run dev, then the specific path the change affects
Responsive check — mobile and desktop widths, plus dark-mode variant if the app has one
Browser console + network tab — no errors, and the expected request/response shape
Loading and error states — exercise both, not just the happy path
sliceExample: Slice 1: types + api method in the apiBoundary (TYPECHECK, LINT). Slice 2: the component consuming it, with loading + error states wired (TYPECHECK, LINT, BUILD). Slice 3: the route/page it lands on plus its e2e spec (BUILD, E2E_TEST).
triggerVocabulary: components, pages, routing, hooks, contexts, state, API client, styling, storefront, OCC API client, cart, checkout
_notes: Starter profile for a React + Vite + TypeScript storefront. Adjust versions to the app after install.

The repo's CLAUDE.md is authoritative: functional components + named exports, ALL backend calls through the apiBoundary (src/services/api.ts), typed responses, loading + error states on every async op, Tailwind class ordering with dark: variants.

E2E_TEST assumes Playwright, matching the changeTypeVerbs mapping for '*.spec.ts|tests'. If the target repo has no playwright.config.* or no specs, change E2E_TEST and E2E_TEST_ONE to 'MANUAL: no e2e runner' and drop the spec/tests mapping — do not leave a mapping pointing at a verb that cannot run. UNIT_TEST ships MANUAL because React repos vary; if a unit runner lands, point it at that and add it to the ts|tsx mapping.
A verb that runs zero tests is not a pass. Read the reported count before calling a checkpoint green.
Counterpart profile: composable-storefront (Angular Spartacus). Same qrspi skill — only the config differs.
Set jira.mode to 'mcp' if the Atlassian MCP connector is available; 'manual' otherwise; 'none' if no Jira.
